messages.campaign_fixture.quest.following.title: Campaign fixture: follow the mentor
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.following.descrip: Walk with the same mentor to the meeting place. The guide waits for the enrolled players.

campaign_fixture.quest.following.offer.l: Come with me. We can speak at the meeting place.
campaign_fixture.quest.following.reminde: Stay close and follow me to the meeting place.
